Class WaitingListMapper

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.utils.WaitingListMapper
public class WaitingListMapper extends Object
Mapper for Waiting List entity conversions.

Handles conversions between: - ResultSet → Waiting entity (database to object) - Waiting entity → WaitingListResponse DTO (object to API response) - WaitingListRequest DTO → Waiting entity (API request to object)

    • mapWaitingRequestToWaiting

      public static Waiting mapWaitingRequestToWaiting(com.andreibel.message.DTO.WaitingListRequest request)
      Maps a WaitingListRequest DTO to a Waiting entity.

      Converts incoming API request to internal entity format. Auto-generates confirmation code and initializes waiting status. Note: waitingDateTime should be set by the service layer to current time.

      Parameters:
      request - the WaitingListRequest DTO from API
      Returns:
      Waiting entity ready for persistence

    • mapOrderToWaitingList

      public static Waiting mapOrderToWaitingList(Order request)
      Maps an Order entity to a Waiting entity.

      Used when an order cannot be seated immediately and needs to be added to the waiting list. Auto-generates a new confirmation code.

      Parameters:
      request - the Order entity to convert
      Returns:
      Waiting entity ready for persistence with the order reference
